name: no-a11y-regression
description: trigger: remediating accessibility, editing markup, emptying or removing an alt, aria-label, label or lang that an element already had, deleting a flagged element. avoid: breaking a requirement the previous revision met; interrupting a correct fix. Misses: a name lost while an element moves to another file, a new element or a supplied name that is weak (these warn and do not block), and Thymeleaf th:attr, which sets several attributes at once. Not production-grade: caught 34 of 51 regressions and refused 6 of 58 correct changes on the 2026-11-15 hardening review's pairs, measured 2026-11-28; known gaps are JSP, ERB, Pug and Lit syntax, an icon component whose own children hide its name, and an alt removed in some forms.
